predict.question: B has 60 minutes, with ten work and two coordination minutes per complete delivery. What is B’s toy result?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: Team Topologies distinguishes interaction modes between teams, including collaboration and consuming another team’s service.
modelBoundary: A completes {A} work minutes; B completes {B}. Each ten-minute delivery still happens, but the stipulated interaction cost falls from ten to two. Interface costs are invented; this does not simulate cognitive load or the book’s organizational outcomes.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? The arithmetic follows our assumptions; real-world applicability and book attribution remain unverified.
